features.description: Benchmark gate: medium vs large at 1920x1080 and 2560x1440, RSS, load time, M2 Air estimate; stop if not viable
features.notes: VIABLE. M4 Max 40c, vsync off, 30 s flight, host load 3-7. medium/large: 1920x1080 frame p50 8.31/8.43, p99 10.07/10.99 ms; star pass GPU p50 0.08/0.34, p99 0.35/0.76 ms; 2560x1440 p99 11.23/11.48 ms, star pass p50 0.10/0.35, p99 0.56/0.99 ms; load_tiers 0.11/0.64 s; static mem 97/248 MB, video 1014/1132 MB. M2 Air estimate (x5-6 GPU): +1.4 ms p50 star pass, ~1 s load. No flux cull needed.
